text: **Cobblestone pavement** is most common in the northeast and in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: **石塊路面**在東北部和南里奧格蘭德州最常見。

text: The section of NR15 from Muhanga till the Western Province border has very **poor pavement**, with a lot of potholes and a lack of road lines.
text_zh: NR15 從穆漢加（Muhanga）到西部省邊界的這段路面狀況**非常差**，有許多坑洞且缺乏道路標線。

text: The section of NR15 from the Western Province border to [this point](https://maps.app.goo.gl/g4dL5u31ULbJrdXw9) is under construction, with no pavement at the moment; making it the only covered National Road to be unpaved for this long. Also, most of the road hugs a steep cliffside made of red dirt.
NOTE: Non-national roads are often unpaved, but they are usually not as wide, and have more stuff going on around them.
text_zh: NR15 從西部省省界到[這個地點](https://maps.app.goo.gl/g4dL5u31ULbJrdXw9)的路段目前正在施工中，暫時沒有鋪裝路面；使其成為唯一一條長期未鋪裝的國道。此外，大部分道路都緊鄰由紅土構成的陡峭懸崖邊。
注意：非國道通常是未鋪裝道路，但它們通常沒那麼寬，且周圍的環境元素比較雜亂。

text: Many roads in **Butare** feature **cobblestone pavement**.
text_zh: **布塔雷（Butare）**的許多道路都採用**鵝卵石路面**。

text: Interstate highways, US highways, and some state roads have **rumble strips** on each edge of the road, which are small indentations in the pavement perpendicular to the road. These can be located on the outside edges of the road and in between lanes on multi-lane highways.
NOTE: Rumble strips may appear in Canada, but are much more rare.
text_zh: 州際公路、美國國道以及部分州道在道路的每一側邊緣都有**減速震動帶**，這是道路鋪面上垂直於路面的一系列小型凹槽。這些凹槽可以位於道路的外側邊緣，以及多車道公路的車道之間。
注意：減速標線可能會出現在加拿大，但非常罕見。

text: These **rectangular raised pavement markers** are found in the south and west of the US and also in Massachusetts.
text_zh: 這些**長方形突起路標**常見於美國南部和西部，以及麻薩諸塞州。

text: **Snowplowable raised pavement markers** can only be found on highways in the eastern states shown in the image. They are built into the road and somewhat resemble the letter H.
text_zh: **除雪機專用突起路標**僅見於圖片中所示的東部各州高速公路上。它們內嵌於道路中，外形有點像英文字母 H。

text: Rectangular pavement markers **each on the side of the double lines** are commonly found in Georgia, Florida, Texas, and California. Other rectangular RPM states have the RPM between the double lines.
NOTE: Beware of similar patterns in left turn lanes.
text_zh: 位於雙黃線**兩側**的長方形路標常見於喬治亞州、佛羅里達州、德州和加州。其他長方形路標（RPM）州的 RPM 則位於雙黃線之間。
注意：請小心左轉車道中的類似圖樣。

text: Roads with **reddish pavement **lined with **long **[**Argentine needle-grass**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nassella_tenuissima)** **are common in San Luis.
text_zh: 鋪有**紅色路面 **，兩旁長著**長長的 **[**阿根廷針茅**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nassella_tenuissima)** **的道路在聖路易省很常見。

text: The pavement which the trekker walks on in Minsk is mostly **grey rectangular tiles**. On a small part, there are [pink-ish tiles](https://goo.gl/maps/jBJvXJYu2yqYENLw9) in a specific pattern.
text_zh: 徒步拍攝者在明斯克走的人行道大多是**灰色矩形地磚**。在小部分區域有呈特定圖案的[粉紅色系地磚](https://goo.gl/maps/jBJvXJYu2yqYENLw9)。

text: This type of pavement, consisting of rectangular **grey bricks **with slightly wavy edges, is very common in El Alto.
text_zh: 這種由邊緣微波浪狀的矩形**灰色磚塊 **鋪成的路面，在埃爾阿爾托非常常見。

text: The section of Ruta 5 around Chaco, just north of Sucre, has distinct **sunset coverage**. Most of this road has concrete pavement, and meanders through semi-arid hills.
text_zh: 蘇克雷正北方 Chaco 周圍的 Ruta 5 路段擁有獨特的**夕陽街景覆蓋**。這條道路的大部分鋪有混凝土路面，並蜿蜒穿過半乾旱的丘陵。

text: The section of Ruta 6 between Tarabuco and Zudáñez is paved with **extremely light-coloured concrete**, bordering on white. This pavement is very recognizable and unique to this road.
text_zh: Tarabuco 和 Zudáñez 之間的 Ruta 6 路段鋪有**顏色極淺的混凝土**，接近白色。這種路面非常容易辨認，且是這條道路獨有的。

text: Puyehue National Park can be recognized by the dense vegetation surrounding the road. The pavement itself has triple yellow lines, and **tar snakes** are frequently seen. In the east, many [**dead trees**](https://goo.gl/maps/vvvheTYM3U7XohwK9) can be seen with a lack of leaves.
text_zh: 普耶胡埃國家公園（Puyehue National Park）可以透過環繞道路的茂密植被來辨認。路面本身有三黃線，並且經常可以看到**補路瀝青（tar snakes）**。在東部，可以看到許多缺少樹葉的 [**枯樹**](https://goo.gl/maps/vvvheTYM3U7XohwK9)。

text: Bantam Village can be recognized by the **cross-hatched** brick pavement.
text_zh: 班坦村可以透過**交錯網紋**的磚造路面來識別。

text: In Colombia, it is particularly common for sidewalks to be decorated with **reddish tiles**.
text_zh: 在哥倫比亞，人行道用** reddish 磁磚**（紅褐色磁磚）裝飾的情況特別常見。

text: Another major divided highway is the RN 32 from the intersection with RN 4 to Limón on the Caribbean coast. The road passes through lush forests in the generally flat Northern lowlands.
NOTE: Aside from the stretch of the RN 1 with concrete pavement, all other major divided highways are in close proximity to San José.
text_zh: 另一條主要的分隔高速公路是從與 4 號國道交叉口通往加勒比海岸利蒙的 32 號國道。該道路穿過大致平坦的北方低地中的茂密森林。
注意：除了鋪有混凝土的 1 號國道路段外，所有其他主要的分隔高速公路都緊鄰聖荷西。

text: The Punta Leona Resort, which can be found by the “Playa Mantas” POI, can be recognised by the **red brick pavement**, with the bricks having the same shape as you’ll commonly find in [Turkey](https://www.google.com/maps/@40.7468922,31.6196471,3a,48.1y,163.7h,64.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sxgSFnYGwZ7tHRph3WXoxAA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 蓬塔萊奧納度假村（Punta Leona Resort）位於「Playa Mantas」地標旁，可以透過**紅磚鋪面**來辨識，這些磚塊的形狀與你在[土耳其](https://www.google.com/maps/@40.7468922,31.6196471,3a,48.1y,163.7h,64.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sxgSFnYGwZ7tHRph3WXoxAA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)常見的形狀相同。

text: Most of the coverage in Filadelfia de Guanacaste was taken on the edge of a park, with a distinct red brick pavement where the bricks are placed in the shape of an “L”.
text_zh: 瓜納卡斯特菲拉德爾菲亞的大部分覆蓋都是在公園邊緣拍攝的，這裡有著獨特的紅磚鋪面，磚塊排列成「L」形。

text: Croatia’s capital Zagreb has a distinct **big city feel**. Apartment** **blocks can be seen throughout the city. The northern part of the city is hilly. Furthermore, Zagreb has [blue electric trams](https://goo.gl/maps/HKezsyENV7j4TJ1J7).
NOTE: In addition to regular car coverage, Zagreb also has various urban [sidewalk trekkers](https://goo.gl/maps/55CGuPvKbjzGLv4XA), often made with a Generation 2 camera.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞首都札格雷布有著濃厚的**大城市氛圍**。公寓**大樓**遍布整個城市。城市的北部是丘陵地形。此外，札格雷布有[藍色電動路面電車](https://goo.gl/maps/HKezsyENV7j4TJ1J7)。
注意：除了一般車輛街景外，札格雷布也有各種市區[人行道徒步拍攝街景](https://goo.gl/maps/55CGuPvKbjzGLv4XA)，通常是使用第 2 代相機拍攝的。

text: Streets in downtown Prague are commonly paved with grey and white marble stones, which is also typical for Portugal. They’re often arranged in intricate square mosaics, but some sections are far more [plain](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oUoxqu29WmRibzCF7). NOTE: Similar pavement can be found in much lower volume in [other towns](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yiUMPdyLTC8wHtAB8) too. Consider the apparent size of the city before guessing Prague.
text_zh: 布拉格市中心的街道通常鋪有灰白相間的大理石磚，這也是葡萄牙的典型特色。它們通常排列成複雜的正方形馬賽克圖案，但有些路段要[簡樸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oUoxqu29WmRibzCF7)得多。注意：在[其他城鎮](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yiUMPdyLTC8wHtAB8)也能找到類似的鋪面，但數量少得多。在猜測是布拉格之前，請先評估城市的視覺規模大小。

text: In urban areas, you can sometimes find this pavement consisting of **hexagonal tiles**.
text_zh: 在市區，你 parfois 可以找到這種由**六角形磁磚**組成的人行道。

text: Åland roads have two unique aspects that separate them from the rest of Finland: their pavement tends to have a **red tint**, and they have **dashed** outside road lines that resemble those found in Sweden.
text_zh: 奧蘭的道路有兩個獨特之處，使它們與芬蘭其他地區區分開來：它們的路面通常帶有**紅色調**，並且它們擁有類似於瑞典道路的**虛線**外側道路標線。

text: Downtown Helsinki has a lot of Generation 4 **sidewalk trekker** coverage.
NOTE: This tip is specifically about Generation 4 trekker coverage. Generation 3 sidewalk trekkers can be found in many other Finnish cities.
text_zh: 赫爾辛基市中心有許多第 4 代**人行道徒步拍攝**覆蓋。
註記：這個提示專門關於第四代徒步拍攝街景。第三代人行道徒步拍攝街景可以在許多其他芬蘭城市找到。

text: The CA9, going between Escuintla and the coast, can be recognised by being a **divided highway** with **concrete pavement**.
text_zh: 來往於埃斯昆特拉與海岸之間的 CA9 公路，其特徵為設有**水泥鋪面**的**分隔高速公路**。

text: **Raised pavement markers** in Hawaii will commonly be placed in a specific pattern: a single reflector, followed by four reflectors put close together and then a single reflector, repeating the pattern.
text_zh: 夏威夷的**突起路標**通常會以特定的模式放置：一個單一反光器，接著是四個靠得很近的反光器，然後再一個單一反光器，並重複此模式。

text: Distinct **bright orange** bins can be found on sidewalks.
text_zh: 人行道上可以找到顯眼的**亮橘色**垃圾桶。

text: Lung Wo Road can be recognized by the Hong Kong Island** skyline to the south** and the Kowloon skyline to the north. The road is also in good condition and the sidewalks are clean.
text_zh: 龍和道可以透過南側的**香港島天際線**與北側的九龍天際線來辨識。該道路狀況良好且人行道很乾淨。

text: Lam Kam Road is similar to Fan Kam Road, however it runs in a more **east-west** direction. The road should also feel **busier **with more cars driving along the road and more houses on the sides of the road. In addition, the road is usually wider and a [median](https://goo.gl/maps/Yggjz9dCZCderyto9) containing trees can be seen separating sidewalks near the villages.
text_zh: 林錦公路與粉錦公路相似，但它的走向更偏**東西**方向。這條路應該會感覺**更繁忙**，沿途車輛更多，道路兩側的房子也更多。此外，道路通常較寬，且在村莊附近的人行道之間可以看到種有樹木的[分隔島](https://goo.gl/maps/Yggjz9dCZCderyto9)。

text: Parts of roads NH6 and NH206 southeast of Shillong can be recognised by the presence of khasi pines with distinct **yellow outer road lines** and fresh dark pavement.
NOTE: This is the only road in Meghalaya that uses yellow outer road lines, but these [lines](https://goo.gl/maps/WVhAoJzbH15AGQoG6) exist in other states as well.
text_zh: 西隆東南部的 NH6 和 NH206 公路部分路段可以透過擁有明顯**黃色外側道路標線**和新鮮深色路面的卡西松樹來辨認。
注意：這是梅ઘ拉亞省唯一使用黃色外側道路標線的公路，但這些[標線](https://goo.gl/maps/WVhAoJzbH15AGQoG6)也存在於其他省份。

text: Snow prevention roads, known as ‘Shosetsu’, are found mainly in northwest coastal prefectures. They appear as **tiny circles **in the pavement, and spray warm underground water to clear snow.
text_zh: 稱為「消雪」的融雪路面主要分布在西北沿海各縣。外觀是路面上的**細小圓孔**，會噴出溫熱地下水來融雪。

text: The **A26 **goes from Kandyagash to the intersection of M32/E38.

It has very **bad road quality** throughout, ranging from [poor grainy pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/SutyRPAen8GPgGXP7), to [completely unpaved](https://goo.gl/maps/vAPBAKKBSqP1cY4y5). Apart from the northernmost section, the weather is either cloudy or overcast.
The landscape consists mostly of flat, semi-arid grassy plains.
Driving direction: **North **towards Kandyagash. (Mostly)
text_zh: **A26 **從坎德阿加什延伸至 M32/E38 的交叉口。
它全線的**道路品質非常差**，從[粗糙的顆粒狀鋪面](https://goo.gl/maps/SutyRPAen8GPgGXP7)到[完全未鋪柏油](https://goo.gl/maps/vAPBAKKBSqP1cY4y5)都有。除了最北端路段外，天氣不是多雲就是陰天。
地景主要由平坦、半乾旱的草地平原組成。
行車方向：**向北**朝坎德阿加什。（大部分）

text: The **A17 **going to Ulytau Region can be recognised by the **bad pavement quality**, where the edges of the road are almost crumbling away, along with the **single white middle road line**, which can be dashed or solid. The landscape itself is a grassy steppe, with some fall coloured trees occasionally lining the roads.
[West of Atasu](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8), the sun is distinctly low on the horizon.
NOTE: A small section east of Atasu has [pristine new pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9), which has a slight red tint to it.
Driving direction: **Towards **[**Atasu**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu) from both directions
text_zh: 通往兀魯套州的 **A17 **可以透過**糟糕的鋪面品質**來辨識，道路邊緣幾乎在崩塌，並伴隨著**單一白色中央道路標線**（可能是虛線或實線）。地景本身是草地草原，路旁偶爾點綴著帶有秋色的樹木。
[阿塔苏西方](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8)，太陽明顯在地平線低處。
注意：阿塔苏東方的一小段路擁有[嶄新的 pristine 鋪面](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9)，帶有一點微紅的色調。
行車方向：從雙向**朝向**[**阿塔苏**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu)

text: Going further south, you will reach this next valley, which seems equally dry, but the mountains are more rocky and have **trees** growing on them. The road now has very **bad pavement**, and as such you can see dust clouds.
text_zh: 繼續向南，你將抵達下一個山谷，它看起來同樣乾燥，但山脈更為崎嶇且長有**樹木**。現在道路的**路面狀況很差**，因此你可以看到塵土飛揚。

text: This road going west of Naryn is situated south in the **dry** Naryn valley. You will typically see hills **close** to the road on the southern side. There are also bigger mountains not too far behind. While to the north, there is a wide plain, with hills and mountains in the distance. Many parts of the road also have a pavement with a [salt and pepper-like quality](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4307504,75.7604242,3a,19.2y,69.61h,72.46t,0.49r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfkTujXcKAOpKC3EtfhN0tg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 這條納倫以西的道路位於**乾燥**納倫河谷的南部。你通常會看到南側有**緊鄰**道路的山丘。不太遠的後方也有更大的山脈。而北側則是一個開闊的平原，遠處有山丘和山脈。道路的許多部分還擁有具有[胡椒鹽般特質](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4307504,75.7604242,3a,19.2y,69.61h,72.46t,0.49r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfkTujXcKAOpKC3EtfhN0tg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的路面。

text: Coverage was taken along parts of the promenade in Beirut, with a grey brick pavement and a large number of fan palms.
text_zh: 部分街景是沿著貝魯特的海濱長廊拍攝的，帶有灰磚人行道和大量的扇椰子。

text: The ER211 can be recognized by the dark pavement combined with its exposed brownish soil.
text_zh: ER211 可以透過深色路面結合裸露的棕褐色土壤來辨識。

text: **Grainy **pavement with a** blue-ish grey tinge** is a common sight for the states of Tamaulipas and Nuevo Leon.
NOTE: In Tamaulipas, larger roads very commonly feature [dashed outer lines](https://goo.gl/maps/J82S2uF1oZ7qGhEG6).
text_zh: 帶有**藍灰色調**的**顆粒狀**路面是塔毛利帕斯州（Tamaulipas）和新萊昂州（Nuevo Leon）常見的景象。
注意：在塔毛利帕斯州，較大的道路非常常出現[虛線外側標線](https://goo.gl/maps/J82S2uF1oZ7qGhEG6)。

text: This style of **cobblestone pavement**, unorganised with irregular tiles, can be found in most of the central states, but is by far most commonly found in the states of Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, and Queretaro.
text_zh: 這種風格的**卵石路面**雜亂無章且磁磚不規則，可以在大多數中部各州找到，但以納亞里特州（Nayarit）、哈利斯科州（Jalisco）、科利馬州（Colima）和克雷塔羅州（Queretaro）最為常見。

text: This pavement consisting of **hexagonal tiles** is found in Puebla and Tlaxcala.
text_zh: 這種由**六角形磁磚**組成的路面可以在普 Puebla（普埃布拉州）和特拉斯卡拉州（Tlaxcala）找到。

text: This exact pavement design with **three lines** of cobblestone patterning is mainly found in Oaxaca.
text_zh: 這種具有**三條**卵石圖案線條的精確路面設計主要在瓦哈卡州（Oaxaca）找到。

text: The capital city, Ulaanbaatar, is by far the biggest city in Mongolia, with about 50% of the entire country's population living in it. As such, its urban development and sheer size is unlike anywhere else in Mongolia. The cityscape is bustling with many **high rise buildings**, chain stores, travelling cars, buses, and pedestrians, as well as clean roads and sidewalks. Meanwhile, the suburbs can be recognized from the [vast yurt districts](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9272927,107.008841,3a,29.5y,301.6h,86.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sYXiArLUQKXIXelnn6G9MXQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) in **hilly areas**. Generation 4 coverage is common, however Generation 3 [winter coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.809762,107.161727,3a,133.2y,242.8h,87.43t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sR3u-gHu194XNWIm0UrWpZw!2e0) is also common to see in the suburbs.
text_zh: 首都烏蘭巴托是蒙古絕對最大的城市，全國約有 50% 的人口居住於此。因此，它的都市發展和規模是蒙古其他地方無法比擬的。市容繁華，有許多**高樓大廈**、連鎖店、行駛的汽車、公車和行人，以及乾淨的道路和人行道。同時，郊區可以從**丘陵地區**的[廣闊蒙古包區](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9272927,107.008841,3a,29.5y,301.6h,86.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sYXiArLUQKXIXelnn6G9MXQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)中辨認出來。第四代街景很常見，但第三代[冬季街景](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.809762,107.161727,3a,133.2y,242.8h,87.43t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sR3u-gHu194XNWIm0UrWpZw!2e0)在郊區也很常見。

text: The other main desert highway in Mongolia runs through Mandalgovi, and can be differentiated from the Choir Highway by its **cloudy skies**, darker pavement, and deep blue tent instead of the tentless car.
text_zh: 蒙古的另一條主要沙漠公路穿過曼德戈壁，可以透過其**多雲的天空**、較深的鋪面以及深藍色帳篷（而不是無帳篷的車輛）來與喬伊爾公路區分。

text: This map shows pavement type as well as the driving direction on all major roads.
text_zh: 這張地圖顯示了所有主要道路的路面類型以及行車方向。

text: Between Gibeon and Tses, the road has wider shoulders, and the pavement quality in general is excellent.
text_zh: 在吉本和特塞斯（Tses）之間，道路的路肩較寬，鋪面品質整體而言非常優秀。

text: You can recognise this long stretch of B8 by the **light coloured grainy pavement** as well as the general E-NE angle and vegetated northern landscape.
text_zh: 你可以透過**淺色帶顆粒的鋪面**以及大致朝東北的走向與有植被的北部地景，來認出這段長長的 B8 路段。

text: Red tinted and slightly grainy pavement along with the green savannah-like grassy landscape crowned with [low-lying cumulus clouds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sThNdCyePnA6XouS9) can be used to recognise the northern section of road C35.
text_zh: 帶有紅色調且微帶顆粒的鋪面，搭配點綴著[`低矮積雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sThNdCyePnA6XouS9)的綠色疏林草原般草地景觀，可用來辨識 C35 公路的北部路段。

text: South of the C41 intersection, the road loses its red pavement, and the quality worsens. The landscape is less grassy, and more sandy, with [hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HByXtaekqiaUQGk77) to the west, though often hidden behind the vegetation. The road generally goes in a S-SE direction. Further south, it gets hillier, and parts will have a more SE bound angle. The sky is consistently covered by scattered [cirrostratus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6hbEGCHVQJKwN58A) and [cumulus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d26SpmrumkcZVnv36) clouds.
text_zh: 在 C41 交會處以南，道路失去了紅色鋪面，品質也隨之惡化。地景上的草變少、沙變多，西方有[`山丘`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HByXtaekqiaUQGk77)，雖然經常被植被遮擋。道路大致呈南南東走向。再往南走，地勢變得更多山，部分路段的走向會更偏東南。天空一直被散布的[`卷層雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6hbEGCHVQJKwN58A)和[`積雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d26SpmrumkcZVnv36)所覆蓋。

text: East of the intersection with the C35, the road has a constant SW to NW angle, and grainy pavement. The grass looks soft to the touch, and the somewhat sandy soil is typical of this region. Cumulus clouds dot the sky.
[West of the C35 intersection](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9jXSgyXW1W6ZBLUL7), the same grainy pavement and clouds remain, but the landscape is much hillier, and the road angle changes.
text_zh: 在 C35 交會處以東，道路有著持續的西南至西北走向以及帶顆粒的鋪面。草摸起來似乎很柔軟，帶點沙質的土壤是這個區域的典型特徵。天空中點綴著積雲。
[`在 C35 交會處以西`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9jXSgyXW1W6ZBLUL7)，相同的帶顆粒鋪面和雲層依舊存在，但地景變得多山許多，道路角度也隨之改變。

text: Often fairly **poor quality pavement** with [only white road lines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Jf6P3gTK1pfE144b9), [no road lines at all](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RNMAWUQFhJFheYrK6), or just slightly [faded road lines and red tinted pavement](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JyFSRjp81cNB64Wz6), are all good clues for the C49 in the panhandle. Near the western end, the [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tGh9NAzuqvDdPpjF7) is very low in the sky, and the weather is fully clear.
NOTE: A [small section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vvEApEqhL8fBQX6G6) by Makolonga has good pavement with wide shoulders, so look for the orange patches on the road.
text_zh: 通常品質相當**差的路面**，且[只有白色道路標線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Jf6P3gTK1pfE144b9)、[完全沒有道路標線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RNMAWUQFhJFheYrK6)、或是僅有稍微[褪色的道路標線與帶有紅色的路面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JyFSRjp81cNB64Wz6)，都是狭長地帶中 C49 的好線索。靠近西端時，[太陽](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tGh9NAzuqvDdPpjF7)在天空中的位置非常低，且天氣完全晴朗。
注意：Makolonga 旁的一[小段路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vvEApEqhL8fBQX6G6)擁有良好的路面與寬闊的路肩，所以請注意路面上的橘色補丁。

text: The D3600 and the [unlabelled road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RTqENPBLvJo7fsBd6) going NE to Mpungu, have a very light coloured, sometimes grainy pavement, with at times [very faded yellow lines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X3ZNNmiVtCtcwsiC9), which are hard to even see. Combined with the either exactly N to S or NE angle, as well as the northern landscape, make this road very distinct.
text_zh: D3600 以及通往姆普古 (Mpungu) 的[未命名道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RTqENPBLvJo7fsBd6)（東北走向），有著非常淺色、有時帶有顆粒感的路面，並伴隨著有時[非常褪色的黃色標線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X3ZNNmiVtCtcwsiC9)，甚至很難看清楚。結合剛好是正南北或東北的角度，以及北方的地景，使得這條路非常獨特。

text: A few roads in the north lack the typical outer yellows.

- The [C46](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A2iuCsBL27yXdx5L8), which is a long road going generally NW to SE. The [E-W section by Ruacana](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TkmT5fLgDYyqJGRC7), has very poor pavement. [SE of Oshikuku](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8ETt6hv4choo1q9B6), the sun is low in the sky to the NW.
- [C41 (M123)](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oe2n4NQt2GrYct8G6) also has a NW angle but has more clouds in the sky than the C46.
- [B10](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pj18CXj2apN1rFNF9) west of Eenhana is an E-W stretch, which is more vegetated, and also has the sun low in the sky to the west.

- [B10](https://maps.app.goo.gl/t2rL31dKFVdiAHhs7) east of Nkurenkuru is another NW bound stretch with the sun low in the sky, but this part is much more vegetated than the C46. You can also see the [moon](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DSwUn3Fn5S9pfiVW7) to the east.
- [D3615](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xk6TXPZPYkXYuShh7) is a short road with a constant N-NE angle that technically has outer yellows, but they are quite faded.
text_zh: 北部的一些道路缺乏典型的外側黃線。

- [C46](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A2iuCsBL27yXdx5L8) 是一條長路，大致由西北走向東南。[盧阿卡納（Ruacana）附近的東西向路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TkmT5fLgDYyqJGRC7)路面非常糟糕。[奧希庫庫（Oshikuku）東南方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8ETt6hv4choo1q9B6)，西北方的天空太陽很低。
- [C41 (M123)](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oe2n4NQt2GrYct8G6) 也有西北走向的角度，但天空中的雲比 C46 更多。
- 恩漢納（Eenhana）以西的 [B10](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pj18CXj2apN1rFNF9) 是一個東西走向的路段，植被較多，且西方天空中的太陽也很低。
- 恩庫倫庫魯（Nkurenkuru）以東的 [B10](https://maps.app.goo.gl/t2rL31dKFVdiAHhs7) 是另一個西北走向的路段，太陽位置很低，但這部分的植被比 C46 茂密得多。你還可以看到東方的[月亮](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DSwUn3Fn5S9pfiVW7)。
- [D3615](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xk6TXPZPYkXYuShh7) 是一條短路，有著持續的北-東北走向角度，嚴格來說它有外側黃線，但它們相當褪色。

text: Langstrand is a small resort town between Swakopmund and Walvis Bay with **pink brick sidewalks** next to essentially every road. The weather is always **overcast **and gloomy.
text_zh: 朗斯特蘭（Langstrand）是斯瓦科普蒙德和鯨灣港之間的小型度假小鎮，幾乎每條道路旁都有**粉紅色磚造人行道**。這裡的天氣總是**陰天**且陰沉。

text: Most Dutch **sidewalks** use the same type of square grey tiles and offset tiling pattern. In some historic areas, you might find smaller [brick sidewalks](https://goo.gl/maps/57mi9meFyFNVCbun9).
text_zh: 大多數荷蘭的**人行道**都使用同款灰色方形磁磚，並採用交錯拼貼圖案。在一些歷史城區，你可能會找到較小的[磚造人行道](https://goo.gl/maps/57mi9meFyFNVCbun9)。

text: **Baarle** is a town in the south of the Netherlands which contains a number of Belgian enclaves. Throughout the town, you can sometimes see signs of this, such as markings on the pavement and [Dutch and Belgian flags](https://goo.gl/maps/sKCBPk8vqM9AUrmB9) being flown together.
text_zh: **巴勒**是荷蘭南部的一個城鎮，包含多個比利時飛地。整個城鎮中，你偶爾可以看到這類的跡象，例如路面上的標記以及同時飄揚的[荷蘭與比利時國旗](https://goo.gl/maps/sKCBPk8vqM9AUrmB9)。

text: Just west of ميتان, only labelled in Arabic on Google Maps, literally translating to methane, there is a stretch of road, which has a uniquely light-coloured pavement. To the north, you can see [sand dunes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHoRRV2ud19p4Jbz9).
text_zh: 就在米坦（ميتان，在 Google 地圖上僅有阿拉伯文標示，直譯為甲烷）的正西方，有一段路面顏色獨特較淺的道路。往北看可以看到[沙丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHoRRV2ud19p4Jbz9)。

text: Neatly **tiled sidewalks** are very common in Poland. Tiles are often grey or light red. Occasionally, even roads have tiled pavement. Many different types of tile patterns occur, including [larger square tiles](https://goo.gl/maps/8S5B5uDchRQ47vD36).
text_zh: 整齊的**磁磚人行道**在波蘭非常普遍。磁磚通常是灰色或淺紅色。偶爾連道路都有磁磚鋪面。會出現許多不同類型的磁磚圖案，包括[較大的方形磁磚](https://goo.gl/maps/8S5B5uDchRQ47vD36)。

text: Similarly, cobblestone sidewalks made of distinctly **bright stones** are very common.
text_zh: 同樣地，由明顯 **明亮石塊** 組成的石板人行道也非常常見。

text: **Cobblestone pavement** is notably common in [Kaliningrad](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cAtPVWR2WxLiyS8V8), [Nizhny Tagil](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iUD3LBhJYxSxdHFeA) in Sverdlovsk, and [Kizel](https://goo.gl/maps/2rLUZD6Rvei7qWwXA) in Perm Krai.
text_zh: **鵝卵石路面**在[加里寧格勒](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cAtPVWR2WxLiyS8V8)、斯維爾德洛夫斯克的[下塔吉爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iUD3LBhJYxSxdHFeA)以及彼爾姆邊疆區的[基澤爾](https://goo.gl/maps/2rLUZD6Rvei7qWwXA)特別常見。

text: Saint-Pierre is the capital and largest town. The coverage in this town is made with a **sidewalk trekker**. Larger buildings and more cars can be seen, with a more populated feel compared to Miquelon-Langlade.
text_zh: 聖皮耶是首都與最大城鎮。此城鎮的街景覆蓋是使用**人行道徒步拍攝**拍攝的。相較於密克隆與朗格德，這裡可以看到較大的建築物和較多車輛，給人更熱鬧的感覺。

text: You can find this **grainy**, almost Texas-like pavement with a hint of **pink **in Limpopo.
text_zh: 你可以在林波波省找到這種帶有一絲**粉紅色**的**粗糙**、幾乎像德州一樣的路面。

text: The stretch of the E45 going between Orsa and Älvros can be recognised by the **brown-red wet pavement** with forest consisting of thin pines and birches along the roadside.
text_zh: 奧爾薩（Orsa）和埃爾夫罗斯（Älvros）之間的 E45 公路路段可以透過**棕紅色濕潤路面**來識別，路旁有由細松樹和樺樹組成的森林。

text: Pavement with **white speckles** is commonly found along the east coast.
text_zh: 帶有**白色斑點**的路面在東海岸相當常見。

text: The islands east of Taitung, Green Island and Orchid Island, are distinct due to the more **tropical** climate, abundance of coconut palms, and lush cliffs. Additionally, it is common to find run-down, **concrete** pavement.

NOTE: While the landscape between Green Island and Orchid Island are quite similar, a good way to distinguish the two is that Green Island frequently uses **yellow outer lines**. Additionally, Green Island is slightly more built-up.
text_zh: 台東東方的綠島與蘭嶼特徵鮮明：氣候更**熱帶**、椰子樹繁多、崖壁植被茂密，另外也常見老舊的**水泥**路面。
註：綠島與蘭嶼的地貌相當接近，但綠島經常使用**黃色邊線**，這是很好的分辨依據；此外綠島的開發程度也略高一些。

text: Lienchiang County, also referred to as the Matsu Islands, is recognizable from the hilly landscape and frequent use of **concrete roads**. The coverage is **overcast** and [this pavement](https://www.google.com/maps/@26.2025968,119.9695409,3a,48.8y,276.8h,91.84t,2.84r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3KR53okaioyHthx43kE3bQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) can also commonly be found.
text_zh: 連江縣（馬祖列島）可由丘陵地形與大量的**水泥路面**辨認。街景多為**陰天**拍攝，[這種路面](https://www.google.com/maps/@26.2025968,119.9695409,3a,48.8y,276.8h,91.84t,2.84r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3KR53okaioyHthx43kE3bQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也很常見。

text: An offroad from road P12 southwest of Sousse can be recognised by the dark pavement surrounded by bright sandy soil combined with the east-west road angle. The eastern part of the road is fairly vegetated, with large numbers of prickly pears, while the western part of the road is [very arid](https://maps.app.goo.gl/W7Q3a5DgLqsJuio59) with little to no vegetation.
text_zh: 從蘇薩西南方的 P12 公路岔出的非鋪裝道路，可以透過明亮砂質土壤環繞的深色路面，結合東西走向的道路角度來辨識。道路東半部植被相當茂盛，有大量的仙人掌，而道路西半部則[非常乾燥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/W7Q3a5DgLqsJuio59)，幾乎沒有植被。

text: Many roads have pavement with a grainy “**salt and pepper**” texture.
text_zh: 許多道路的路面具有帶顆粒感的「**胡椒鹽**」質地。

text: **Brick pavement** is very common in urban areas, and the bricks will typically have the shape shown in the image.
text_zh: **磚造路面**在市區非常普遍，而且磚塊通常會呈現圖片中所示的形狀。

text: A **poorly paved runway** can be seen going north to south on the Midway Atoll. The pavement gets increasingly poor to the [north](https://goo.gl/maps/d45BgC8WQFuxeAE67).
text_zh: 在中途島可以看到一條**鋪設不良的跑道**由北向南延伸。路面越往[北](https://goo.gl/maps/d45BgC8WQFuxeAE67)越糟糕。

text: The **only paved road** with coverage outside Kampala can be found here. The pavement almost entirely lacks the red tinge which is typical for most roads in the country. The road has white, solid outer lines and a yellow middle line.
A power line runs parallel to the road, to your east. To your north, you will be able to see hills.
text_zh: 坎帕拉以外擁有街景覆蓋的**唯一鋪面道路**就在這裡。這條柏油路幾乎完全沒有該國多數道路典型的泛紅色調。道路兩側有白色實線外緣線，中間則是黃色中線。
一條輸電線路與道路平行，位於你的東側。在你的北側，則可以看到群山。

text: On average, Ukraine has some of the **worst roads** in Europe. Most rural roads have lots of potholes, cracks and warped pavement.
This abysmal road quality can really help with tough 50-50s with Russia, which generally has somewhat better roads.
text_zh: 平均而言，烏克蘭擁有歐洲**最差的道路**之一。大多數鄉村道路都有許多坑洞、裂縫和扭曲的路面。
這種極差的道路品質對於應付與俄羅斯的艱難五五波猜測非常有幫助，俄羅斯的道路通常稍微好一些。

text: Houses in residential areas are typically made of **light-coloured stone**. Reddish stones are often used for sidewalks.
text_zh: 住宅區的房屋通常由**淺色石材**建造。人行道經常使用帶紅色的石頭。

text: In some parts of Dubai, including the [old town](https://goo.gl/maps/CXsP5xq4fAtX7Ds47), a Generation 4 **sidewalk trekker** was used. Sometimes, the employee’s black hair is visible.
text_zh: 在杜拜的某些地區，包括[老城區](https://goo.gl/maps/CXsP5xq4fAtX7Ds47)，使用了第 4 代**人行道徒步拍攝**。有時可以看到員工的黑髮。

text: **Texan roads** often have a grainy, ‘salt and pepper’-like road surface.
NOTE: [Similar pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/ChBAJda4PYN38dJ1A) can sometimes be seen in adjacent states such as New Mexico, Oklahoma, and Colorado.
text_zh: **德州道路**的表面通常帶有顆粒感，呈「鹽與胡椒」般的道路材質。
注意：[類似的路面](https://goo.gl/maps/ChBAJda4PYN38dJ1A)有時也能在鄰近的州看到，例如新墨西哥州、奧克拉荷馬州和科羅拉多州。

text: Some rural roads in the Upper Midwest use a similar road pavement to [Texas](https://goo.gl/maps/GeXiD3RdkjUkGMWr9). They will have a **grainy, ‘salt and pepper’-like road surface**, but will vary in colour. These roads are most common in the state of Illinois.
text_zh: 上中西部的一些鄉間道路採用了類似[德州](https://goo.gl/maps/GeXiD3RdkjUkGMWr9)的道路鋪面。它們會有**顆粒感、呈「鹽與胡椒」般的道路表面**，但顏色會有所不同。這種道路在伊利諾州最常見。
